proposals.description: Build repeatable AI evaluations with test cases, rubrics, baselines, graders, failure taxonomies, and regression thresholds.
Test agents and retrieval systems against hostile instructions, data exfiltration, and tool manipulation.
Evaluate agent tools, credentials, write access, approvals, and least-privilege boundaries.
Check OpenAPI contracts, implementations, examples, errors, versioning, and backward compatibility.
Inspect row-level security policies for cross-tenant exposure, privilege escalation, missing coverage, and unsafe defaults.
Plan and validate reversible migrations, backfills, compatibility windows, and rollback procedures.
Detect exposed credentials, unsafe examples, excessive scope, and weak rotation practices.
Evaluate vulnerabilities, abandonment, licensing conflicts, malicious-package risk, and upgrade exposure.
Produce and validate software bills of materials with provenance and dependency relationships.
Identify undocumented differences across infrastructure, application, and security configurations.
Convert evidence and timelines into blameless, actionable incident reports.
Design and evaluate exercises for outages, ransomware, dependency failures, and regional disruptions.
Define useful logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, service indicators, and alerts.
Evaluate tests, migrations, security, documentation, rollback readiness, and release evidence.
Record context, alternatives, tradeoffs, consequences, and reversal criteria for technical decisions.
Convert policy language into controls, owners, evidence, tests, and exception handling.
Map personal-data flows, purposes, retention, sharing, user rights, and privacy risks.
Generate dataset cards describing provenance, population, collection, limitations, intended use, and bias.
Evaluate utility, leakage, duplication, bias, and re-identification risk in synthetic datasets.
Package data, code, environments, parameters, provenance, checksums, and reconstruction instructions.
Compose and audit evidence-traceable academic, technical, policy, proposal, and executive writing from explicit briefs and source registers.
